    import causalkit

    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().resolve() / "src"))
    import causalkit

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

                     "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3})
